title: Qualification and remaining work
text: dev16 recorded single-thread live ooRexx ↔ SWI email callback demonstration. dev17/dev18 corrected mutually exclusive PL_cut_query/PL_close_query in source and explicitly did not qualify rebuilt native binaries. dev19 submitted the correction to GitHub Autobuild on branch autobuild-submit/20261023T154700Z-CHATGPT-oorexx-prolog-dev19-7c2a91 commit 15b66f274d4cd44c586ae232ddaa981bab6bf5b3. Acceptance receipt not observed at submission time. Next: compiled native test for FIRST/REDO/PRUNED exactly-once cleanup; retained roots on exception/exhaustion; engine reuse; thread attachment and concurrent close/cut; reentrant callback safety. Source contract tests alone cannot close these gates. 2026-10-29 direct source hardening commit c35d80a7ea02c98fbeaaf27e0b884cc6d8725f9a gates q->closed and ooRexx root release on successful PL_cut_query/PL_close_query status, refusing PL_S_NOT_INNER and failed finalization; tests/test_finalizer_status.py is structural only. Uncertain finalizer outcomes, SWI cleanup-handler exceptions, nested queries and leak-free shutdown remain unqualified.
